shortDescription: Config FortiWeb Advanced Protection Custom Policy Rule

options.name: bot_confirmation
options.description: Enable to confirm if the client is indeed a bot.

options.name: bot_recognition
options.description: Select what type of bots the client is.

options.name: mobile_app_identification
options.description: Available only when Mobile Application Identification is enabled.

options.name: name
options.description: A unique name that can be referenced in other parts of the configuration.

options.name: security_action
options.description: Select which action the FortiWeb appliance will take when it detects a violation of the rule.

options.name: severity
options.description: Select which severity level the FortiWeb appliance will use when it logs a violation of the rule.

options.name: trigger
options.description: Select which trigger, if any, that the FortiWeb appliance will use when it logs and/or sends an alert email about a violation of the rule.
